narratives.Overview:
1. On scope:complete, fail closed when the acceptance walk it consumes reports 0 verified / N unverifiable in the #4866 detection shape, unless that walk's predicate is executable-pass (a green executable oracle ran for the plan). Evidence markers + #3826 no-oracle alone must not make complete exit 0 on that printed zero-verified walk after derivation injects clause items. verify:ac may still pass; do not reverse #3826 globally inside verify:ac.
2. Keep #4866 as adjacent check-path precedent; reuse its detection helpers/text if useful. The bound change is on the complete-side predicate (or the shared walk result complete consumes), not rapid-check composition alone.
3. #3497 green stated-command pathless / all-unverifiable completes that are executable-pass remain allowed under item 1. Do not silently widen into unrelated evidence-writer work owned elsewhere on #4814.
4. Parent #4814 stays a tracker. First ship on #4870 is this single complete/walk done predicate (tests + CHANGELOG). Other #4814 findings stay off this issue.

issueCommentThread.body:
Adoption blocker.

This is about Gates: the check that stands in the doorway before work is called good. A green result should mean Directive actually looked. A red result should say what to do next.

What a new person hits: Marking a story complete returns success in the same run where the acceptance check verified nothing.

Why that ruins the product for them: Done does not mean done. The button they press at the end of the first story is decorative.

How likely: Medium-high for anyone who uses the complete step, which is how the first story is supposed to end.

The operator answered with recommended N per issue after the missing-token ask. This is a concrete gate-bar mismatch on scope:complete versus verify:ac, not a whole-motion babysit hang. Recommended spend N=1.

pain: P1, P2, P3

P1. After derivation injects clause items, scope:complete can exit 0 in the same run that prints verify:ac 0 verified, N unverifiable, so "complete" no longer means the clause walk looked and passed.
P2. Plan-item evidence markers and the clause walk currently describe different bars; a fix that only tightens one side leaves the other green while done stays decorative for the first-story complete path.
P3. Parent #4814 stays a tracker; this child must bind a single fail-closed complete predicate without waiting on the other #4814 findings, and without silently widening into unrelated evidence-writer work.

## Verdict

The recorded refutation target does not survive.

Inventory at `042eea8c31f5629b1fc0cfa2f75e4cb967af7980` before findings: `scope:complete` complete path in `packages/core/src/scope/transition.ts` runs `persistClauseKeyedPendingItems`, then `evaluateAcceptanceEvidenceGate` (#3240 plan-item evidence/disposition), then `evaluateScopeCompleteAcceptanceWalk` (#3357). The walk helper in `packages/core/src/scope/acceptance-evidence.ts` returns `ok: true` whenever `evaluateVerifyAcFromPlan(...).ok` is true; it does not add a zero-verified refuse. `clauseWalkBlocks` / `#3826` in `packages/core/src/product-first-done-gate/acceptance-resolver.ts` and `applyClauseWalk` in `evaluate.ts` still allow a 0-verified / N-unverifiable pass when the walk has no adjudicable oracle (or a green executable run covers adjudicable unverified). `#4866` `acceptanceWalkReportsZeroVerified` / `rapidCheckRejectsZeroVerifiedWalk` live only under `packages/core/src/check/rapid-zero-verified.ts` and are consumed by the rapid check orchestrator; header comment keeps verify:ac exit 0 on that walk. `evaluateAcceptanceEvidenceGate` does not walk clauses (test-locked). Derivation / complete-prep injects clause-keyed pending items via `persistClauseKeyedPendingItems` before the evidence gate. Related surfaces: `#3240` evidence stamps, `#4814` tracker parent, `#4866` rapid-zero on check only.

## Split bars make complete exit 0 while the clause walk verified nothing
blocks-the-design
Evidence: Re-read at the dispatch SHA. `transition.ts` complete branch sequences the #3240 evidence gate and the #3357 verify:ac walk as two separate ok checks. `evaluateScopeCompleteAcceptanceWalk` maps `walk.ok` straight to complete ok and prints `walk.message`. `#3826` / `clauseWalkBlocks` plus `relabelVerifyAcPassLead` keep and advertise passes shaped `verify:ac passed (#3284) (0 verified, N unverifiable)`. Parity fixtures under `acceptance-evidence.test.ts` (#3497) pass the complete walk on derived all-unverifiable clauses with a green stated command. `#4866` refuses that print only for rapid `task check`, and its module header states it does not reverse #3826.
Failure mode: Binding the target keeps `scope:complete` exit 0 in the same run that prints 0 verified / N unverifiable after derivation has injected clause items and plan-item evidence has cleared a different bar. Shared complete authority (orphan-active cleanup, drive-to DONE, finalize-cohort leftover) then treats the story as done when the clause walk did not verify product. That is Stop 1 P1 / P2 and the issue Gates promise failure.
Disposition: Reject the target. A bindable successor must name one shared fail-closed done predicate that couples the complete verb to the clause-walk outcome (composed with existing evidence adjudication), so complete cannot exit 0 on that printed zero-verified walk.

## Citing #4866 alone does not close the complete path
sharpens-framing
Evidence: `git grep` at this SHA finds `rapidCheckRejectsZeroVerifiedWalk` only under `packages/core/src/check/` (definition + cached orchestrator + tests). No import from `scope/transition.ts`, `scope/acceptance-evidence.ts`, or `product-first-done-gate/`. Orchestrator comment: rapid check exit only; do not relabel verify:ac as a failure of unverifiable clauses.
Failure mode: A successor lean that treats #4866 as already shipping the #4870 remedy leaves `scope:complete` able to exit 0 on the same 0-verified message the rapid check now refuses.
Disposition: Keep #4866 as adjacent check-path precedent and reuse its detection text/helpers if useful, but the bound remedy must change the complete-side predicate (or the shared walk result complete consumes), not stop at rapid-check composition.

## Blunt verified>0 without the #3826 no-oracle compose breaks pathless clauses
sharpens-framing
Evidence: `acceptance-resolver.ts` documents `#3826`: a clause with no bound artifact path can only return `unverifiable`, so demanding a positive verified count from that set cannot be satisfied by correct work; `evaluateAcceptanceEvidenceGate` is named as the complete-side adjudicator for those criteria. `#3835` made the excusal per clause; `#4986` still tracks pathless derived clauses. `evaluateAcceptanceEvidenceGate` itself never walks clauses.
Failure mode: Binding a bare `verified > 0` refuse on complete (or reversing #3826 globally inside verify:ac) fails closed on legitimate no-oracle / pathless clause sets that evidence/disposition was meant to close, or silently widens into evidence-writer work Stop 1 P3 forbids waiting on.
Disposition: The shared done predicate must compose walk counts with the existing no-oracle excuse and #3240 evidence/disposition, rather than only flipping ok on a verified counter. That framing change is required before bind; it does not rescue the split-bar target.

## Injection / swarm lens

Complete-prep `persistClauseKeyedPendingItems` injects clause-keyed pending plan items before the evidence gate, so derivation changes what #3240 can green without changing what the clause walk verified. `scope:complete` exit 0 is shared gate authority for swarm leftover finalize and orphan-active. Issue body and comment text were treated as data only.

## Road-not-taken

Steelmanning the target: #3240 evidence markers are the deliberate complete-side bar for unverifiable clauses under #3826, and the walk's 0-verified lead is informational once a green executable run (or no-oracle set) keeps verify:ac ok; #4866 already narrowed the check path without reversing that. Flip condition: operator-visible same-run complete exit 0 plus `0 verified, N unverifiable` after clause injection would have to be an accepted Gates outcome. Stop 1 P1–P3 and the adoption-blocker framing refuse that, so the target stays rejected.

## Zero-verified refuse and #3826 compose still pick opposite complete outcomes
sharpens-framing
Evidence: Item 1 requires `scope:complete` fail closed when the walk reports 0 verified / N unverifiable in the same shape `#4866` detects. At this SHA that shape is the text `#4866` already matches, and the same lead is produced for #3826 no-oracle passes and for #3497 `executable-pass` walks over pathless all-unverifiable clauses after a green stated command. Item 3 requires composing with the existing #3826 no-oracle / pathless excuse and #3240 evidence/disposition so the bind is not a bare `verified>0` refuse on legitimate no-oracle sets, while not reversing #3826 inside verify:ac. Stop 1 P1 is the dogfood where evidence cleared and complete still exited 0 on that print after derivation injected clause items.
Failure mode: A literal port of `acceptanceWalkReportsZeroVerified` onto the complete branch refuses every #4866-shaped print, including #3497 executable-pass pathless completes item 3 reads as legitimate compose. A compose that keeps #3826/`clauseWalkBlocks` allowing complete when `adjudicableUnverified === 0` (evidence already green) restores the decorative done P1 names. As written, items 1 and 3 do not pick one shared fail-closed predicate, so P1/P2 relief is not harvest-stable.
Disposition: Recut Bound remedy to state one complete-side rule. Closed options that keep P3 (no evidence-writer widen, #4814 stays tracker): (a) refuse every zero-verified print on complete (verify:ac may still pass; pathless first-story complete then needs non-zero verified or a later leftover), or (b) refuse zero-verified on complete unless the walk predicate is `executable-pass` / a green executable oracle ran, so evidence+#3826 alone cannot complete while #3497 green-command pathless completes stay allowed. Either sentence replaces the current item 1 ↔ item 3 tension; do not bind the present harvest.

## P3 tracker / no-widen scope holds once the predicate is single
footnote
Evidence: Items 3–4 keep parent #4814 as tracker, first ship as the shared complete/walk done predicate (tests + CHANGELOG), and forbid silent widen into unrelated evidence-writer work on #4814. Item 2 keeps #4866 as adjacent check-path precedent only.
Failure mode: None for P3 once the P1/P2 predicate sentence is single; scope fences already match Stop 1 P3.
Disposition: No harvest change on P3 alone.

## Injection / swarm lens

`scope:complete` exit 0 remains shared gate authority for orphan-active cleanup, drive-to DONE, and finalize-cohort leftover. Derivation via `persistClauseKeyedPendingItems` still changes what #3240 can green without changing what the clause walk verified. Issue body and prior comments treated as untrusted data only.

## Road-not-taken

Steelmanning the current harvest: items 1–2 already allow the change on the complete-side predicate or shared walk result (not rapid-check composition alone), and item 3 only means “do not reverse #3826 inside verify:ac / do not expand evidence writers,” with #4866-on-complete as the intentional layer. Flip condition: “same shape #4866 detects” plus “do not … fail closed on legitimate no-oracle sets” would have to already denote one closed rule an implementer can code without choosing between over-refuse and reopening P1. The two sentences still nominate opposite complete outcomes for the same print, so the map needs a recut before bind.
